title: 405 NW 5th Street
summary: The August 18 agenda recorded an improper mailed notice, a public hearing, and no action. The city re-advertised the rezoning for September 1.
proposal: R-1 Suburban Single-Family to T4.2 Neighborhood Node under standard review.
significance: The procedural reset is the signal: the first hearing produced no action, so the proposal remains pending.
next_step: The advertised Planning Commission hearing is scheduled for September 1; no decision is recorded.

title: Three final plats
summary: Echelon Subdivision, Walnut Grove Phase IV, and Brier Hill Phase II appear on the September 1 consent agenda.
proposal: Final plats FP26-0003, FP26-0004, and FP26-0005 for three residential subdivision locations.
significance: The records show three platting actions arriving in one meeting cycle; phase numbering does not establish construction activity.
next_step: Planning Commission consideration is scheduled, followed by separate City Council action and recording if advanced.
non_claims: Lots are not represented as conveyable

title: 209 W. Locust Street

next_step: The case was carried to September 1 for another Planning Commission opportunity; City Council would decide any rezoning separately.
non_claims: No site plan or construction status reviewed
